name: Reliant Forge
tagline: Deploy a site or app with no account, and lint and generate forge projects
description: The MCP server of forge, an open-source Go + React framework and CLI. Its 14 tools deploy a static site or app with no account (a live URL plus a claim link; an unclaimed deploy goes offline after 72 hours), explain a forge error and the next command, list what forge and the project already have, load forge's playbooks, and run forge lint and forge generate.
